sourceNotes: 新增 macOS 15 及以上可选网络监视组件，仅查看新连接并放行全部连接，不读取通信内容
后台控制服务按需启动、空闲退出，暂停或隐藏监视页面后停止读取连接
支持在 XStats 的组件管理面板检查更新和卸载组件，更新与主程序独立管理

en: Add an optional network monitoring component for macOS 15 or later that observes new connections, allows all traffic and never inspects communication content
Start the background control service on demand and exit when idle; pausing or hiding the monitor stops reading connections
Check for updates and uninstall from XStats component management, with component updates managed independently of the main app
